_note: Kokoro phonemes (misaki US set: A=ay as in 'day', O=oh, I=eye, W=ow, Y=oy; ˈ before the stressed vowel). Add every player name that a check fails on, then re-run.
_pronounce_note: pronounce: correct pronunciation per name for audit/pronounce.py. ipa = space-separated phones (General American), alt = accepted variants, say = respelling to type into VoiceStudio when the plain spelling is said wrong. Source every new entry (team site / broadcast / player intro), never a guess. wrong = known mispronunciations: a name FAILS when it sounds closer to one of these than to the right one.
